scope: Real main.js, engine.js and home-design.js with external renderer stub; normal UI rename/blur/history/save controls; no graphics claim
checks: Empty Workshop starts with both history controls disabled.
First rename on blur immediately enables Undo.
Undo restores original name in state/input and enables Redo.
Redo restores the edited name in state and input.
Rename after Undo creates a new branch, disables Redo and keeps Undo enabled.
Normal Save click after blur persists the latest name and marks layout saved.
Reload reopens the latest persisted name.
Preview BOOK creates a pending model without mutating the layout.
Name-only blur preserves a pending BOOK ghost and its inspector.
Place after naming the pending preview actually adds BOOK.
Blank position marks the BOOK preview invalid.
Name-only blur preserves the blank position and invalid ghost.
Place with blank position remains refused after naming, without a new history entry.
Focused name/history flow has no page errors.
